summary: Established in 2002 with partnership offices in 17 countries, your firm has a strong story, but broken menu links and unfinished testimonials hold it back.

findings.problem: About and Legal Newsroom in the menu and footer link to #, and there is no contact form on the page.
findings.cost: A client who wants to learn about you or reach you hits a dead end.
findings.fix: Working About and News pages and an enquiry form.

findings.problem: The ESTHITMAR HOLDING entry has a logo and name but no testimonial text, the first review has no attribution, and Madlife CEO, Tech Corp looks like a placeholder.
findings.cost: Unfinished testimonials look unreal and weaken your best proof.

findings.problem: Typos include partnershop offices across 17 countries, clients' s trust and call on them and her. The firm name appears as Al Sulaiti, Al-Sulaiti Law Firm and Legal Consultations and Al-sulaiti.
findings.cost: Errors on a law firm page lower trust.
findings.fix: Proofread copy and one firm name.

findings.problem: Read more about [area] repeats 12 times, there is no clear primary action above the fold, and Best Law Firm in Qatar for Business has no evidence.
findings.cost: Clients are not told what to do next, and unsupported claims weaken trust.
findings.fix: One clear call to action and evidence for claims.

redesign: A clear enquiry path with a form, WhatsApp and click to call.
Complete testimonials, partner profiles and one consistent firm name.
